title.official: ISO/IEC 42001:2023 Information technology — Artificial intelligence — Management system

relevance.reason: The first international management-system standard for AI. It specifies requirements for establishing, implementing, maintaining and continually improving an AI management system. It is a voluntary technical standard, not law, and is sold by ISO.
ai_provisions: Whole standard — AI management system requirements and controls
relevance.excluded_scope: Voluntary technical standard; no legal obligation and no public full text.

dates.notes: Publication month December 2023; the exact publication day was not verified. Edition 1, 51 pages.

status_note: Published international standard. Certification is voluntary; national adoption may vary.

languages.note: ISO publishes English and French versions; the ISO catalogue lists English and French. No treaty-style authentic-language clause.

sources.note: Official catalogue page: published December 2023, edition 1, 51 pages, ISO/IEC JTC 1/SC 42.

rights.note: The standard is sold by ISO. This corpus stores metadata and a link only; it does not reproduce or circumvent access restrictions.

checks.result: Technical standard; no binding legal effect.
